matchTitle: If any of your federal loans are Parent PLUS: consolidate before July 1, 2026 to preserve income-driven access
note: Parent PLUS borrowers must consolidate into a Direct Consolidation Loan before this date to preserve access to an income-driven repayment plan.

matchTitle: File §83(b) election within 30 days of grant
note: An 83(b) election must be filed with the IRS no later than 30 days after the property is transferred (the grant date). The window is statutory and not extendable.

matchTitle: Plan §83(b) filing ahead of any restricted-stock or early-exercise grant
note: When a grant occurs, the 83(b) election must be filed within 30 days of that grant date. The window is statutory and not extendable.
The legacy income-driven repayment plans (PAYE, ICR, SAVE) are sunset in July 2028; borrowers must migrate to a remaining plan before the shutdown.
